summary_1line: Shiva, disguised as a Kirata hunter, confronts Arjuna after they simultaneously slay a demon boar, leading to a fierce but mysterious duel.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna and the Kirata hunter release arrows at the same instant, both shafts striking the charging demon boar as it crashes across the Himalayan forest floor.
Shiva disguised as a towering golden Kirata descends on the Himalayas with Uma and a wild host of spirits, the forest suddenly falling silent.
Arjuna unleashes a storm of arrows from the Gandiva while the unmoving Kirata stands smiling, the shafts striking him harmlessly like rain against a mountain.
